item.title: Daybreak — Sep 5
item.itunes:title: Daybreak — Sep 5
item.description: A blowout 162,000 payrolls print tripled forecasts and pushed September Fed hike odds to 65%, colliding with Trump's threat to halt trade with surplus countries unless the Fed cuts — rate-hike repricing and Fed-independence risk now trade as one package. Top stories: US Adds 162,000 Jobs, Triple Forecasts; September Hike Odds Jump to 65%, Stocks and Bonds Sell Off; Global Bond Yields Hit Multi-Decade Highs; El-Erian Warns Sell-Off Continues on Buyer Shortage; Fed Chair Warsh Scales Back Forward Guidance, Sowing Confusion and Fatter Term Premiums. Trades: Long refined-product crack spreads and energy equities; short 30Y Treasuries and French OATs vs Bunds; long gold targeting $4,600 on payrolls-driven Fed confusion; short CAD on 50% tariff threat; overweight US/European defense.

item.description: US fiscal stress hits $40T debt, Treasury buyback fails to cap yields, dollar slides; Iran war escalates with Hormuz near-shutdown, oil above $93; AI capex boom continues with Broadcom $100B debt and Anthropic IPO plans. Top stories: US National Debt Breaches $40 Trillion; Treasury Doubles Buybacks, Bond Yields Hit 25-Year High; US Stocks Plunge 703 Points as Treasury Buyback Fails to Calm Rising Yields; Oil and Walmart Weigh; Walmart Shares Tumble 9% on Slowest US Sales Growth in Six Years; $2.9B Tariff Refund Used for Price Cuts. Trades: Long gold/silver on debasement trade; short US long-duration Treasuries; long European defense stocks; long Bitcoin on Clarity Act momentum; short consumer discretionary on Walmart weakness; long energy equities on supply disruptions.
